verdict.rationale: First-party docs cover each stage of bring-up. Drivers: you name a hardware model in the config and viam-server pulls and initializes the Registry driver automatically. Setup: a guided first-machine wizard plus searchable models (rpi5, xArm6, webcams). First motion: browser test panels to drive bases and move arms without deploying code, backed by a motion service. Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on corroboration of the hours-not-weeks timeline, no explicit time-to-first-motion claim, and unsupported hardware still requires writing a custom driver module on Linux-class compute.
